additional_context: The old profile.xsd and source/profile/profile-spreadsheet.xml inputs are no longer present in the current checkout. The current tracked ElementDefinition source at source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml contains the corrected definition, and source/fhir.ini maps elementdefinition into the active type-page build area. Community searches found no relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The reconciliation is an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch documenting that the historical fix persists in current build source.
